title: Explicit determination of a class of permutation rational functions in any characteristic
summary: In this paper, we make use of the classification results of low-degree permutation rational functions together with their geometric properties to investigate rational functions that induce permutations on the multiplicative subgroup mu_q+1, where q is a prime power. By carefully analyzing the structural conditions under which such rational functions permute muq+1, we obtain an explicit description of a broad class of permutation rational functions of small degree.
